## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or performance

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build` passes
- [ ] New or changed logic has tests
- [ ] Model output is validated with Zod and any claims are backed by verified quotes
- [ ] UI changes are keyboard accessible, labelled, and do not rely on colour alone
- [ ] No secrets, real contracts or personal data are included
- [ ] Copy stays within legal information and does not give legal advice
